name: A New Ore Sample
summary: Tatternack Steelforge in Camp Taurajo has heard rumors of an unusual mineral deposit carried by kobolds far to the south. Determined to satisfy Warchief Thrall's demand for stronger arms, he sends Horde adventurers into Thousand Needles to secure an unrefined ore sample for testing.

sections.title: A Smith's Ambition
sections.body: Operating out of the dusty outpost of Camp Taurajo, the blacksmith Tatternack Steelforge works under the direct scrutiny of Orgrimmar. Having already supplied weaponry made from local centaur armaments, Tatternack remains driven to prove his craft to Warchief Thrall. When passing travelers refused to sell him a strange piece of ore they looted from a kobold to the south, Tatternack took the refusal as an insult to both his craft and the Horde.

sections.title: Venture into Thousand Needles
sections.body: The quest takes Horde scouts out of the flat plains of the southern Barrens and into the towering canyon mazes of Thousand Needles. There, subterranean vermin dig through the crags and cliffs. By prying unrefined mineral chunks directly from the local kobold diggers, adventurers return with the raw material Tatternack needs to evaluate whether this new stone can be forged into weapons worthy of Thrall's war effort.

faq.answer: Tatternack Steelforge is an orc weaponsmith stationed at Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens. He is dedicated to crafting weapons to supply the Horde's frontier defense and regularly seeks new materials to impress Warchief Thrall.

faq.q: Where does this ore sample come from?
faq.answer: The unrefined ore sample is found carried by kobolds inhabiting the winding canyons of Thousand Needles, situated directly south of the Great Lift bordering the Barrens.

faq.q: Why is Tatternack angry at the passing travelers?
faq.answer: A group of travelers arriving from the south showed Tatternack a strange mineral chunk taken from a slain kobold, but refused to sell it to him. Tatternack viewed their hoarding of vital materials as an unpatriotic insult to the Warchief and cursed them as cowards.

faq.q: What will Tatternack do with the ore?
faq.answer: He intends to analyze its metallurgical properties and test its strength. If the metal proves durable enough, he plans to forge a prototype weapon from it and present it directly to Warchief Thrall in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: What prerequisite must be completed before this task?
faq.answer: Before taking this mission, you must complete 'Weapons of Choice,' in which you gather specific weapons from the various centaur tribes threatening Camp Taurajo to prove the local armaments can be repurposed.

faq.q: Why are kobolds in Thousand Needles carrying this ore?
faq.answer: Kobolds are compulsive burrowers and miners who tunnel relentlessly through crags and subterranean veins. In Thousand Needles, their digging has uncovered unusual subterranean deposits that surface-dwellers have rarely touched.

angles.text: For smiths of the Horde, securing new and exotic metal deposits is essential to keeping the frontier armed against surrounding threats.
Camp Taurajo acts as a vital southern bastion, and contributing materials directly aids the Warchief's military preparedness.
Prospectors understand the value of raw, unrefined veins unearthed by burrowing creatures in unexplored southern canyons.
